other_failure_modes.name: Invalid lag features for multi-step forecasting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes time-series lag features by shifting a target column that is initialized to NaN in the test set. For multi-step forecasting, this causes all lags beyond the initial horizon to be NaN, severely degrading model performance since it does not iteratively predict and fill the target.

other_failure_modes.name: Look-ahead bias in time-series CV
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses standard K-fold cross-validation on time blocks without respecting chronological order, meaning the model is trained on future data to predict past data. This introduces look-ahead bias and leads to overly optimistic validation scores.

summary: The agent builds a structurally complete pipeline with extensive feature engineering and a decoupled model approach for consumption types. However, it introduces two critical time-series flaws: it computes target lags on the test set without an iterative forecasting loop (causing most test lags to be NaN), and it uses a non-chronological cross-validation scheme that suffers from look-ahead bias.
